title: Collections: indexes, fields, keys, and a real copy
goal: Choose how to address data and distinguish an array alias from an independent flat copy through observation.

prerequisites.text: Complete BSL fundamentals: variables, types, conditions, and loops. Know how to preserve a separate source and run your training infobase.

sections.title: Why this task matters
paragraphs: Separate variables are convenient for two requests. A dozen needs a collection. But a collection is not one universal container: element order, named record fields, and key lookup answer different questions.

Read the worked example and predict a changed input. The independent task uses a different contract. Save the previous training source before replacing a module; a personal Nexus mark is not an assessment of your explanation.

sections.title: An array preserves a sequence
paragraphs: Our requests now take different durations: 30 and 45 minutes. Массив preserves a sequence. Добавить appends an element; the first index is 0, so МинутыЗаявок[0] is 30. There are two elements and the last valid index is 1.

Для Каждого visits the values in turn. The accumulator starts outside the loop: after 30 it is 30, after 45 it is 75. Reordering these numeric inputs changes traversal order but not their sum. An invalid index is an error, not a request for an imaginary zero.

sections.title: The complete worked example and its result
paragraphs: The complete handler stores 30 and 45 in an array, sums 75, names Клиент and Минуты in a structure, and maps a separate key to 75. The three messages 30/75/75 are similar-looking numbers obtained through different addressing methods.
Match code and result by each statement’s role. Explain matching output through inputs, execution order, and state; one observed run does not check every possible variant.

sections.title: A structure names the fields of one record
paragraphs: Карточка has Клиент and Минуты fields. Карточка.Минуты communicates meaning more clearly than an arbitrary index. Structure field names must be suitable property identifiers. Several unrelated fields do not become a sequence of requests merely by being placed together.

The duration field receives the computed 75. This is an in-memory structure; creating it does not write a catalog item or database document. For an optional field, use Свойство("FieldName", Value) rather than assuming a misspelling returns an empty string.

sections.title: Trace the important transitions
paragraphs: ВтороеИмя = МинутыЗаявок does not create another object. Adding 15 through the alias gives three elements in the original array. An independent flat copy needs a new array and transferred elements; this alone is not a deep copy of nested mutable objects.
Before the next statement, record state separately from messages already displayed. This finds the first divergence rather than guessing from the final line.

sections.title: Your prediction before revealing
paragraphs: Add a third duration 15 before summation. What are the Минуты field and mapped value?
Write your answer before revealing it. Identify the changed input and unchanged rule, then compare with the changed example.

reveal.title: Check the prediction
paragraphs: Match the changed values with the same rule. This checks transfer rather than memorisation of the previous final line.

sections.title: A map associates a key with a value
paragraphs: Соответствие is useful for lookup by key rather than position or a predefined field name. "Клиент-А" is an educational label here. A changeable customer name is not reliable identity in a real application; later lessons introduce catalog references. Inserting the same key replaces its associated value rather than appending a second array row.

Получить on a missing key returns Неопределено, which differs from a stored numeric zero. Do not add an unknown value to a duration without deciding what absence means. It might indicate that the total has not been calculated. Check the expected value and its type first.

sections.title: A faulty variant and its first divergence
paragraphs: Replace КопияМинут(Исходный) with Копия = Исходный. Assigning 99 at index 0 makes both names show 99. This visibly violates preservation of the original 10. A new variable name or Знач parameter does not promise another object.
Keep the faulty variant separately. Restore the working version and repeat the positive case. Do not change an expectation merely because the program printed something else.

sections.title: Two variables can name the same mutable object
paragraphs: ВтороеИмя = МинутыЗаявок does not create an independent array. Both variables access the same mutable object; an append through one is visible through the other. Build a new array and transfer values for an independent flat collection. Nested mutable objects need an additional copying decision.

A preservation check compares actual contents before and after, not just variable names. An empty array leaves this accumulator at zero under our chosen rule. A text value among numeric durations needs a different response: detect and reject it rather than trusting its numeric appearance.

sections.title: See the values and direction
paragraphs: The diagram unfolds the selected sequence. Labels do not replace code: match each transition to a statement and record what remains unchanged.

Two names can point to one array. Новый Массив creates another container; transferring the numbers fills it. Changing a copied element leaves the source number unchanged. This concerns a flat numeric array, not arbitrary nested objects.

sections.title: Now a different independent task
paragraphs: The original flat array contains 10 and 20. Make a separate copy by transferring numeric elements; set copied element 0 to 99. Display original first element 10, copied first element 99, and copied count 2. Array[7] gives 7/99/1; an empty array givesempty/empty/0 without indexing 0.
The worked example is not a ready solution to this task. Use a separate starter; reveal the reference on request after your own attempt. Viewing it must not replace saved or unsaved work.

sections.title: How to check transfer
paragraphs: Obtain 10/99/2,7/99/1 andempty/empty/0 for the respective cases.
Label each control input, expected observation, and reason in advance. Use rejection where the contract requires it; do not turn an unknown result into a convenient zero.

sections.title: The exact work location in 1C
paragraphs: The complete handler stores 30 and 45 in an array, sums 75, names Клиент and Минуты in a structure, and maps a separate key to 75. The three messages 30/75/75 are similar-looking numbers obtained through different addressing methods.

In your separate training infobase, save the source, update the database configuration, and launch a new session from Designer. Distinguish the editor, saved configuration, and running version; an old session does not prove the new text ran.

paragraphs: Preserve the original array; the empty path must not index a missing element.

The source and expected messages accompany the explanation. Actual images of the complete worked example come from a separate training infobase; they are not your run or proof of your authorship. Record your independent work separately.

sections.title: What is established and what still needs explanation
paragraphs: We copy a flat numeric array, not an arbitrary object graph. A displayed type name can contain a space: the observed type presentation was «Не определено», while the language value is Неопределено. Check type identity rather than label formatting.

Before marking completion, explain one changed input of your own. A technical pass, matching messages, and your completion mark are different facts; understanding is discussed through explanation and transfer.
